ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Browser Child Process - MacOS
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious child processes spawned from browsers. This could be a result of a potential web browser exploitation.

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*com\\\.apple\\\.WebKit\\\.WebContent.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*firefox.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*Google\\ Chrome\\ Helper.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*Google\\ Chrome.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*Microsoft\\ Edge.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*Opera.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*Safari.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*Tor\\ Browser.*")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\/bash$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/curl$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/dash$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ksh$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/osascript$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/perl$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/php$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/pwsh$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/python$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/sh$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/tcsh$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/wget$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/zsh$"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-defaults\\-torrc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Library\\/Application\\ Support\\/Microsoft\\/MAU*\\/Microsoft\\ AutoUpdate\\\.app\\/Contents\\/MacOS\\/msupdate.*") OR ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*Google\\ Chrome\\ Helper.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*Google\\ Chrome.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Volumes\\/Google\\ Chrome\\/Google\\ Chrome\\\.app\\/Contents\\/Frameworks\\/*\\/Resources\\/install\\\.sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Applications\\/Google\\ Chrome\\\.app\\/Contents\\/Frameworks\\/Google\\ Chrome\\ Framework\\\.framework\\/*\\/Resources\\/keystone\\_promote\\_preflight\\\.sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Applications\\/Google\\ Chrome\\\.app\\/Contents\\/Frameworks\\/Google\\ Chrome\\ Framework\\\.framework\\/*\\/Resources\\/keystone\\_promote\\_postflight\\\.sh.*"))) OR (parent_process_path = RGX(".*Microsoft\\ Edge.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*IOPlatformExpertDevice.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*hw\\\.model.*"))) OR ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*Google\\ Chrome\\ Helper.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*Google\\ Chrome.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Users\\/.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Library\\/Application\\ Support\\/Google\\/Chrome\\/recovery\\/.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/ChromeRecovery.*")))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = "None" OR process_command_line = "")
